entities.name: Josef ben Meir ibn Zabara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph ben Meïr Ibn Zabara was a Spanish-Jewish physicist, poet and satirist. Although much of his work has been lost, he is noted as the author of Sefer Sha'ashu'im, or in English, the Book of Delights.
